{{Quote|I was always good with numbers. It was Vaz taught me how I could use it.|Combo|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Combo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A partner of starship thief [[Vaz Traniff]], Combo was captured on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] after a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was out on their heads by [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Raskurro]] was about to hand over Combo to Rogun's [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] enforcer [[Strilth]] when Vaz Traniff and [[Voidhound]] arrived to rescue him. [[Strilth]] was killed, Combo released and Raskurro persuaded to sever the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] ties with Rogun. Afterwards, the Voidhound, Traniff and Combo set out to [[Raid on the King's Ransom|raid]] the Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']] in orbit of the Smuggler's Moon. Vaz and Combo hid in a cargo container while the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] delivered them onto the ship in a stolen Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Though the ''King's Ransom'' was soon destroyed by the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]], Combo and Vaz made it out alive and with plenty of valuable plunder.
